title: Before Explanation · Why read this book?
description: The book tests explanation against evidence, responsibility, power, and the limits of knowledge.

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: What happens before an explanation starts governing reality? This book examines how explanations shape understanding, responsibility, and power in everyday life. It follows the distance between persuasive stories and the realities they claim to describe.
readerInvitation.readerPromise: The book tests explanation against evidence, responsibility, power, and the limits of knowledge.
readerInvitation.audienceFit: readers interested in reasoning, institutions, psychology, and artificial intelligence
readerInvitation.closingInvitation: Read Before Explanation to follow the complete argument, examples, and consequences.
readerOutcomes: Its chapters connect cognitive psychology, institutional decisions, personal relationships, and artificial intelligence.
Readers encounter questions about evidence, uncertainty, competing interpretations, and the boundaries of useful models.
The final part introduces outfinitism as a proposed research programme concerned with limits of knowledge.
